verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents an official Browser Agent SDK made of four composable packages, plus first-voice-agent guides for Python, JavaScript, C#, and Go and an official Node.js starter app. A published OpenAPI spec also supports generating typed clients. missing for 10: explicit documentation of official server-side SDKs for the Voice Agent API (the multi-language guides only imply them), SDK reference depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
